Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses BS3 for chemical cross-linking to determine the structure of the gammaTuRC complex. While not a PTM-enrichment in the classical sense (like phospho), it is a complexome/structural proteomics workflow. iBAQ was used for quantification, which is a label-free approach.

scope: The purified γTuRC complex at a concentration of 0.2 mg/ml in gel filtration buffer... was crosslinked with 2.4 mM disulfosuccinimidyl suberate (BS3)

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (CLMS) was performed specifically on the purified human γTuRC complex, which was isolated from HeLa-Kyoto cells using a biotin affinity purification strategy.

evidence: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD018106.
